```{python}
#| message: false
import os
import pandas as pd

data_dir = ".." if os.path.exists("../students.csv") else "."
students = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(data_dir, "students.csv"))
semesters = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(data_dir, "semesters.csv"))

faculty_name = params['faculty']
merged = semesters.merge(students, on='student_id')
faculty_semesters = merged[merged['faculty'] == faculty_name]
n_students = faculty_semesters['student_id'].nunique()
first_sleep = round(faculty_semesters.loc[faculty_semesters['semester'] == 1, 'sleep_hours'].mean(), 1)
```

This report describes the `{python} n_students` students
of the Faculty of `{python} faculty_name`. In their first semester, they slept
`{python} first_sleep` hours a night on average.

```{python}
summary_table = (
    faculty_semesters.groupby('semester')
    .agg(
        Students=('student_id', 'nunique'),
        Wellbeing=('wellbeing', 'mean')
    )
    .reset_index()
    .round(1)
)
summary_table.columns = ['Semester', 'Students', 'Average wellbeing']
summary_table
```
